title: The Power Of Loaded Language
description:
I’m known as “the quarter billion dollar webinar man” because I’ve sold over $250 million worth of products to over 150,000 customers in 131 countries. On this channel, you’re getting all the insights, techniques and strategies I’ve learned along the way.

I started out as a Hare Krishna monk and a rapper (pretty eclectic, I know!) but these days, most of my focus is spent on strategic positioning. Which simply means that where other marketers will try to figure out the best recipes and how to become a better chef, I’ll figure out how to get the best ingredients in place first… because the best victories in business are won by knowing where and when to play!

Based on these strategic initiatives, I hold the records for all-time biggest launch in the Internet Marketing space ($57.9 million) as well as the record for most commissions generated as an affiliate in a product launch ($9.8 million in 8 days).

If you would like to work together reach out to: Jason@usebrain.com
